description_en: Associates a Virtual Border Router (VBR) instance with shared Express Connect circuits
description_zh: 关联边界路由器VBR（Virtual Border Router）实例至共享专线
name: AttachVbrToVpconn

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the shared Express Connect circuits (VirtualPhysicalConnection), returned by the CreateVirtualPhysicalConnection operation
parameters.name: vpconn_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client token must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token用于保证请求的幂等性。

要保证Client Token在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without associating the VBR instance with the shared Express Connect circuits. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and instance status. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the request ID is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request. After the check succeeds, the VBR instance is directly associated with the shared Express Connect circuits
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值范围：

true：发送检查请求，不会关联VBR实例至共享专线。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、实例状态。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回请求ID。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接关联VBR实例至共享专线
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the shared Express Connect circuits.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
共享专线所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id
